summary: The candidate meets the request and passes all seven criteria. It adds one file, docs/design/reviews/defaults-loop-review-1.md, laid out like the existing reviews, and ends with "accept with changes" and seven numbered changes. I checked the review's code and document citations against the repository and they are accurate: the budgets and check_budget in athena-context/src/lib.rs, render() and parse in defaults.rs, the 12 ids in defaults.toml, the record fields in docs/records.md, the correction kinds in reading.rs, D26, D89, D31, RM-3/RM-4, E12 and the BRIEF lines. Its claim that records/ is absent is also true. It checks the design against every gateway fact the user gave. Its main finding is F1: the design asks Jev to cluster records and draft text, which an evaluate call cannot do. It reports the probe as the user's measurement, says what one probe does and does not show, and flags the garbled cost without guessing a value. No other file changed, and the review contains no personal data. The only problem is a nit: one cross-reference says F3 where it means F2. Separately, the reading's deliverables list says the design doc and CHANGELOG.md would be modified, which contradicts the request; the candidate rightly changed neither.
